outcome_sought: Full refund of the two scam payments (£7,750 in total).
rationale: A safe-account impersonation scam where the customer authorised two Faster Payments, so it is an APP scam for the Fraud and Scams team. The complaint stays on the 8-week clock because APP scams are authorised payments, not a Parts 6-7 PSRs execution issue. She is bereaved, elderly and lives alone, so the excess cannot apply (CP-7.2). Vulnerability is described but no support needs are recorded, and no linked-complaint check is noted.
